Documentary on Gaza AI Allegations Wins Venice Prize Amidst Israeli Official's Criticism

The documentary 'NAZA', which alleges the use of artificial intelligence in Gaza, has won the Special Jury Prize at the Venice Film Festival. Following the award, an Israeli official called for the nationality of the film's directors to be revoked. The documentary's claims focus on the Gaza war.
